name: Dufu Technology Corp. Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订事项；公告主要为季度业绩、股息除权及股份分拆相关的附加上市公告。最新一季（2026-09-30）营收同比增长31.3%，净利润同比增长456.3%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not disclose any expansion, new business, reduction, divestment, or contract wins for its business segments in its announcements; announcements mainly comprised quarterly results, dividend ex-date notices, and additional listing announcements related to share subdivision. For the latest quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue grew 31.3% year-on-year and net profit grew 456.3% year-on-year.
